name: Thief Simulator
desc:
CODE: "50MIL" = 15K CASH [NEW CODE @ 150K LIKES!]

WELCOME to THIEF SIMULATOR where you will become the RICHEST THIEF in the WORLD!

💰 Sell your loot to get CASH!
👮 Beat the timers or get sent to JAIL!
📜 Complete JOBS to UNLOCK better HEISTS!
💪 Upgrade your SKILLS to become a better THIEF!
🛠 Use interactive TOOLS, BACKPACKS & BLUEPRINTS to help you in your HEISTS!
💎 Explore new HOUSES, STORES, BANKS & WORLDS to get better LOOT!

HOW TO PLAY:
💵 Make CASH by robbing NPCs & STEALING LOOT!
💰 Sell your bag for CASH & UPGRADE them to hold more LOOT!
🔨 Buy new TOOLS to unlock new ways to STEAL & LOOT!
🔒 Unlock new HOUSES, STORES, BANKS & WORLDS by purchasing new BLUEPRINTS!
📈 Try to get to the top of the LEADERBOARDS!

Made by Funwise.
